run_trajectory_rollout: run the main function to rollout a control trajectory in the HDMI environment
setup_env_hdmi: setup an HDMI environment for a specific task with configurable episode length
set_state_to_env: set joint positions velocities and control inputs to the HDMI environment
setup_mujoco_renderer: setup a MuJoCo renderer with custom width and height for video recording
render_side_by_side: render a side-by-side comparison image of reference and simulation data
